rationale: BI-7BCC87BB plan B8, AC-OVERRIDE (founder answer to waiver W6 in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-07-approval-convergence-on-envelope-design.md §10). WWMD DI-18258852EB33 chose card-override-exact-link (9.80) over separate-admin-page (6.25) and admin-needs-you-queue (5.52); outcome recorded as followed. The request's own card shows one secondary button, 'Decide on their behalf', only to an admin (manage_users) who is not the delegate; it opens one reason field, and the existing Authorize / Decline pair stays disabled until the reason is non-empty (EnvelopeDecisionButtons gains a disabled prop for that). The admin's Needs-you queue is not widened; the card is reached by the request's exact link or the superuser orphaned-approval item. The settled card and the owner's result history add one line: 'Decided by <admin> on behalf of <owner>: <reason>'. --dpf-* tokens and approvals catalog copy only. The same controls also appear on the supervisor agent card (AgentCardEnvelopeDecision.tsx), under founder decision DI-FFD78D222548, which chose envelope-shared-buttons over link-to-needs-you and v1-adapter. The UX-fit gate does not count that file as adding a control, because it only reuses EnvelopeDecisionButtons and OnBehalfDecision, so the decision is cited here rather than in its own manifest.
verification: CoworkerEnvelopeApproval.on-behalf.test.tsx (offered only to a non-delegate admin, reason required, posts on behalf, names admin/owner/reason, delegate card unchanged); envelope-actions.on-behalf.test.ts and the route on-behalf tests (non-admin non-delegate refused, empty reason refused, audit row). Served-target UX verification is owed by the coordinator (AC-UX).
